interpretation: Concurrency caps whole job pipelines through CPU validation and autoreleasepool cleanup, not GPU kernel parallelism. Measured offsets use epoch_uptime_ns; warmup offsets use warmup_epoch_uptime_ns. Hardware GPU times are separate raw timestamps. Allocation counters are global samples, not per-job deltas or peaks. Working set is advisory, not free RAM. Explicit cap excludes framework internal allocations.
output_hash_encoding: SHA256 row-major Float32 bitPattern little-endian, padding excluded, both signed zeros normalized positive; other bitPatterns preserved.
